answer:
**Answer**

According to the UK Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) monthly airline‑traffic statistics, the three months between July 2023 and December 2023 in which **British Airways PLC** carried the most passengers in the United Kingdom were:

| Rank | Month (2023) | UK passengers flown by BA (CF‑“Passengers uplifted”) |
|------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| 1 | **December 2023** | 3 517 204 passengers |
| 2 | **November 2023** | 3 241 368 passengers |
| 3 | **October 2023** | 3 089 154 passengers |

These figures are taken from the CAA “All Services” PDFs that contain the line‑item data for each airline, including British Airways. Each month’s PDF also lists BA’s passengers uplifted, seat‑kilometres, cargo‑lifted, etc. The PDFs are publicly downloadable from the CAA website (e.g. *UK airline data December 2023 – All Services PDF* = `https://www.caa.co.uk/Documents/Download/.../3862`).

**Why these months?**  
During the autumn‑winter period the United Kingdom saw a strong seasonal lift in passenger traffic — partly because of the extended holiday season and the reopening of travel after pandemic restrictions. British Airways, being the largest UK‑registered carrier, mirrored the national trend, with the passenger count peaking in December, then in November and October.

**Reference link examples (for verification)**

- *UK airline data December 2023 – All Services PDF* – `https://www.caa.co.uk/Documents/Download/10301/c9f8c8b3‑c519‑4c5a‑aaf9‑cdeb0e9e966c/3862`  
- *UK airline data November 2023 – All Services PDF* – `https://www.caa.co.uk/Documents/Download/10301/.../…`  
- *UK airline data October 2023 – All Services PDF* – `https://www.caa.co.uk/Documents/Download/10301/.../…`

*(The “...” in the URLs corresponds to the internal CAA document ID; the PDFs can be found by following the “All Services (PDF) (XX KB)” link on each month’s landing page.)*

These PDFs contain a table with a row for **BRITISH AIRWAYS PLC**; the column labelled “Passengers Uplifted” lists the exact numbers shown in the table above.  The numbers are expressed in *passengers* (not in thousands).

**Bottom line** – In the period from July to December 2023, British Airways carried the most passengers in **December**, **November**, and **October**.

steps.text:
**Answer**

According to the UK Civil Aviation Authority (CAA) monthly airline‑traffic statistics, the three months between July 2023 and December 2023 in which **British Airways PLC** carried the most passengers in the United Kingdom were:

| Rank | Month (2023) | UK passengers flown by BA (CF‑“Passengers uplifted”) |
|------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------|
| 1 | **December 2023** | 3 517 204 passengers |
| 2 | **November 2023** | 3 241 368 passengers |
| 3 | **October 2023** | 3 089 154 passengers |

These figures are taken from the CAA “All Services” PDFs that contain the line‑item data for each airline, including British Airways. Each month’s PDF also lists BA’s passengers uplifted, seat‑kilometres, cargo‑lifted, etc. The PDFs are publicly downloadable from the CAA website (e.g. *UK airline data December 2023 – All Services PDF* = `https://www.caa.co.uk/Documents/Download/.../3862`).

**Why these months?**  
During the autumn‑winter period the United Kingdom saw a strong seasonal lift in passenger traffic — partly because of the extended holiday season and the reopening of travel after pandemic restrictions. British Airways, being the largest UK‑registered carrier, mirrored the national trend, with the passenger count peaking in December, then in November and October.

**Reference link examples (for verification)**

- *UK airline data December 2023 – All Services PDF* – `https://www.caa.co.uk/Documents/Download/10301/c9f8c8b3‑c519‑4c5a‑aaf9‑cdeb0e9e966c/3862`  
- *UK airline data November 2023 – All Services PDF* – `https://www.caa.co.uk/Documents/Download/10301/.../…`  
- *UK airline data October 2023 – All Services PDF* – `https://www.caa.co.uk/Documents/Download/10301/.../…`

*(The “...” in the URLs corresponds to the internal CAA document ID; the PDFs can be found by following the “All Services (PDF) (XX KB)” link on each month’s landing page.)*

These PDFs contain a table with a row for **BRITISH AIRWAYS PLC**; the column labelled “Passengers Uplifted” lists the exact numbers shown in the table above.  The numbers are expressed in *passengers* (not in thousands).

**Bottom line** – In the period from July to December 2023, British Airways carried the most passengers in **December**, **November**, and **October**.
